request.author: Alex Example
request.description:
## Today

Dispatchers plan vehicle assignments in a shared spreadsheet.

- Double bookings are found too late
- Fleet managers have no weekly utilisation view
request.problem: Dispatchers track vehicle assignments in spreadsheets, so double bookings are found too late.
request.outcome: Dispatchers see one live assignment board and conflicts are prevented at booking time.
useCases: Dispatcher assigns a vehicle to a trip
Fleet manager reviews utilisation per week
constraints: No personal data leaves the EU
